source: test/redteam/gate/README*.md and test/redteam/integrity/README.md in codenclawed-cli; transcribed per finding, the attack and status columns are LaTeX

findings.attack: \texttt{git grep -Orm pat}: attached \texttt{-O} value runs a program (deletes matched files)
findings.statusText: fixed: getopt parsing, per-command option specs

findings.attack: committed symlink to \texttt{.git/config}; \texttt{Write} through it skipped the exec-config check
findings.statusText: fixed: check on resolved path; symlinked write asks

findings.attack: \texttt{.GIT/config} on case-insensitive filesystems
findings.statusText: fixed: NFC + case-folded names; wider protected set

\texttt{WebFetch} to any host with secrets in the URL (open flavor)
allowlisted \texttt{git log} runs repository \texttt{core.pager} (TTY)
findings.statusText: fixed: asks when repo config can start a program; residual: user/system git config trusted

findings.attack: \texttt{git cat-file -{}-te}: 2-character abbreviation of \texttt{-{}-textconv}
hard link in project to the audit log; \texttt{Write} tampers the log
hard link to \texttt{.git/config}
quadratic scan on unterminated \texttt{<!-{}-}: minutes of CPU; a killed hook cleans nothing

findings.statusText: fixed: code-point scan, fixed point, lone surrogates stripped

findings.attack: notice imitations via look-alikes, mid-line, NBSP; leaked nonce
findings.statusText: fixed: notices out of band; skeleton matching

findings.attack: 32 nested-escape bytes withheld a whole 20\,KB result
findings.statusText: fixed: one-pass nesting; withhold only the region

findings.attack: legitimate joiners (Persian ZWNJ, emoji ZWJ) stripped

findings.attack: attacker sentence framing a genuine notice
